name: Sevren's Orders
summary: In Brill, Magistrate Sevren sends a proven Forsaken agent to the Undercity. The orders direct the agent to Bethor Iceshard in the Magic Quarter.

sections.title: Summons to the Capital
sections.body: Skilled Forsaken agents who prove themselves against the Scourge in Tirisfal Glades are summoned south as their people strengthen their hold on Lordaeron. Magistrate Sevren writes the orders as an introduction and credentials for Bethor Iceshard, one of the Dark Lady's foremost arcane practitioners in the Magic Quarter. Sevren knows only that the assignment concerns reaching out to an errant lich. The Undercity's high mages give the summons their full authority.

faq.answer: Magistrate Sevren, who oversees Forsaken affairs in Brill, wrote the orders.

faq.q: Who is intended to receive these orders?
aliases: where do i bring sevren's orders
faq.answer: The orders are addressed to Bethor Iceshard, a high-ranking Forsaken mage in the Undercity's Magic Quarter.

faq.q: What is the mission mentioned in the orders?
faq.answer: The orders call for recruiting a wayward lich to aid the Forsaken. The dangerous task falls to an agent already proven against the Scourge.

faq.q: Why was I chosen to deliver them?
faq.answer: Bethor requested an operative proven against the Scourge. Magistrate Sevren judged your efforts in Tirisfal Glades enough to meet Bethor's dangerous request.

angles.text: As an Undead, carrying Sevren's seal takes you from local service in Tirisfal to work for the Undercity's arcane elite.
As a Mage, delivering the orders brings you before Bethor Iceshard, one of the foremost spellcasters in the Forsaken kingdom.
